question: The river Tapi rises in the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satpura range.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **river Tapi** is also known as the Tapti river.
 
• It is one of the major rivers in central India that flows through the states of **Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• The river Tapi originates in the **Satpura range **of central India, near the Multai town in the** Betul district **of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Satpura range is a series of **hills and mountains **that run parallel to the Vindhya range in central India.
 
• It covers parts of **Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Gujarat**, and is home to several wildlife sanctuaries and national parks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Nilgiri hills **are a range of mountains located in the southern Indian states of **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala**.

 
 
• They are known for their** scenic beauty** and are a popular tourist destination.
 
 
 
• The** Aravali range** is a mountain range in western India that runs through the states of **Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, and Delhi**.
 
 
• It is one of the **oldest mountain ranges** in the world and is known for its rich mineral resources.
 
 
 
• The **Himalayan range **is a mountain range in South Asia that runs through several countries including **India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Tibet**.
 
 
• It is the highest mountain range in the world and is home to several of the world's highest peaks including **Mount Everest.**
